title: trailboss --json task show
description: One task, as the card to read before accepting it: an object (not an array) with every field of its `task ls` row, and what it did. The summary is the agent's last message, read from the local index: it's for you, and Trailboss never logs or sends it anywhere.

state.description: queued, to do, working, needs you, reviewing, ready, done or missing; more may be added.

detail.description: Why: the agent's status or what it waits on, or how it ended.

commits.description: Commits on its branch that the base branch doesn't have; once merged, the commits the merge brought in (null when that wasn't recorded); null once removed.

files.description: Files its branch changed; once merged, the files the merge changed (null when that wasn't recorded); null once removed.

uncommitted.description: Changed paths not committed in its worktree; null once done or gone.

where.description: Where its agent runs now, as `live` says; null when none is.

session.description: AGENT:ID of its agent's session: the one live in its terminal, else the latest indexed in its worktree.

outcome.description: merged, removed, or failed (a queued task that couldn't start), once done.

summary.description: The agent's last message in that session; null when none is indexed.

changed.description: Files its branch changed since it left the base branch; once merged, the files the merge changed (`merged`); null once removed, or merged before that was recorded.

path.description: Relative to the repository; `old => new` for a rename.

added.description: Lines added; null for a binary file.

removed.description: Lines removed; null for a binary file.

checks.description: Checks known to have run on its session or in its worktree: `until` loops running there. Empty when none is known.

check.description: The check's command, its words joined by spaces.

by.description: What ran it: until; more may be added.

passed.description: How it ended last time; null before it has run.

evidence.description: What shows the work was checked, newest first: the latest run of each test or build its agent ran, read from the session's transcript in memory (only the check's name, result and time), and the `until` loops that ended on its session or in its worktree in the last 30 days. Absent from output before this field was added; empty when none is known.

source.description: transcript (the agent ran it) or until (a loop ended); more may be added.

command.description: The check: its short name (`cargo test`, `npm run build`) for a transcript run, the command as given for a loop.

passed.description: Whether it passed: its exit status for a transcript run (null when the transcript doesn't say, or it's still running), how the loop's last check went for a loop (null when none ran).

at_ms.description: When it ran (ms since the epoch): for a loop, when its last check started (when the loop ended if no check ran, or for a loop recorded before this was kept). null when the transcript doesn't say.

stale.description: A result, passed or failed, from before the branch's latest commit: it checked older code.

can_accept.description: Whether `task accept <n> --yes` would merge it now.

accept_blocked.description: Why accept would refuse it now, as accept would say; null when it would go through.

log.description: Commits on its branch the base branch doesn't have, newest first (`commits` counts them); once merged, the commits the merge brought in (`merged`); null once removed, or merged before that was recorded.

review.description: Whether a second agent reviews its work before it's ready: `task add --review`, or the config's `tasks.review`; `task review` turns it on.

notes.description: The file its latest reviewer wrote its notes to, once written; null before.

reviewer.description: Its review, when it's on or one ran: the latest reviewer and the notes it wrote, read from their file and printed for you only. Null when review is off and none ran.

reviews.description: Reviewers started for it so far.

agent.description: The latest reviewer's definition; null before one started.

where.description: Where the reviewer runs now, as `live` says; null when it doesn't.

notes.description: The file it was asked to write its notes to, in `task-reviews/` beside the index.

text.description: Its notes (the first 256 KiB); null until written.

commit.description: The task branch's commit the latest reviewer reviewed; null before one started, or for a review recorded before Trailboss kept it.

stale.description: Whether the branch has moved past that commit, so the notes are for an older one: the task is then reviewing, not ready, until it's reviewed again.

merged.description: Once accepted: the base branch's commit before the fast-forward (`from`) and the task's commit it moved to (`to`); `log` and `changed` are that range. null while open, once removed, and for a task merged before this was recorded.

from_branch.description: Made by `branch --worktree`: the session it forked (AGENT:ID) and the turn (`--at`) it forked at, null from its end; null for a task `task add` made. Its branch is `branch/<n>-<slug>`.

queued.description: Whether it waits to start (`task add --queue`, `--after`, `--at`, or past the config's `tasks.max_parallel`): no worktree, branch or agent yet. It starts at a look (`events`, `watch`, the Herdr block) once it's due and there's room.

after.description: While queued: the task it waits for to be accepted (`--after`); null otherwise.

at_ms.description: While queued: the time it waits for (`--at`), in milliseconds since the epoch; null otherwise.

budget_usd.description: Dollars its agent and reviewers may spend between them (`task add --budget`, the config's `tasks.budget`, `task budget`); null without one. Over it, its automatic reviewer and the tasks queued --after it wait until it's raised or cleared; nothing is stopped.

spent_usd.description: What its agent and reviewers have spent so far, at API-equivalent prices, rounded to the cent; null without a budget.

over_budget.description: Whether it has spent its budget; false without one. Its detail says so, and a queued task held by the budget of the task it waits for says that.

auto_review.description: Whether its reviewer starts on its own, at a look, once its agent comes to rest with commits no reviewer has seen yet (`task add --auto-review`, or the config's `tasks.auto_review` for a reviewed task); once per commit.

clashes.description: Each other open task branch or running agent in the same repository changing a file this task's branch or worktree changes since its base; empty once done.

pair.description: The same on both sides' rows: which pair this is.

kind.description: clash (changed lines overlap in a file both change) or same_file (the same files, other lines); more may be added.

with.description: The other side: `task N` for an open task, else where its agent runs.

task.description: The other side's task number, when it's a task.

where.description: Where the other side's agents run; empty for a task with none running.

lines.description: Of those, the ones where their changed lines overlap; empty for same_file.

clash.description: The clashes in a line: "same lines as task 3: src/a.rs; same file, other lines, as t2 api: src/b.rs"; null without any.
